scope: Replace lateral/crossover candidates. Discovery and source screening only; no new training or validation job.
historical_results: Retained unchanged as geometric-offset controls, not selected drift demonstrations.
desired_features: Nontrivial translational momentum at robot scale, not near-stationary yaw rotation
Sustained course change, not merely a constant lateral travel direction
Course-to-wheel or bilateral course-to-foot offsets during contact/proxy contact
Report speed loss throughout the turn; large offsets during a stop are not sufficient
Keep source and retarget measurements separate; no invented individual wheel/foot telemetry
turn_window_policy: Evaluate individual sustained turns/transitions with unwrapped course. Whole-clip endpoint course change can cancel on a full circle or figure-eight and must not reject those motions by itself. Window selection must be reported before training or friction evaluation.

exploratory_robot_reference_screen.qualification: Inherited exploratory screen, not user-specified physical limits. Retaining 80% of speed does NOT mean zero deceleration. Source-FK screening is not a robot-reference pass.
